title: Specify the canonical Agent loop and Skill integration contract
goal: Define a source-grounded, testable contract for wiring Skill selection and verified execution into M6 without reversing package dependencies or weakening policy.
context: Source review confirms the Skill subsystem exists but is not connected to the canonical M6 path: context skills are empty, planning emits nil skillID, ActionProposal cannot carry skill identity, and the existing SkillAgentOrchestrator does not handle ApprovalGate semantics.
forbidden_changes: Do not claim this document implements runtime integration.
Do not modify source, UI, package graph, or policy behavior in this documentation task.
Do not claim tests or CI prove runtime Skill integration.
acceptance_criteria: Document current verified code facts and clearly mark the proposed contract as not implemented.
Specify dependency direction, selection/fallback, authorization/approval, execution verification, cancellation, audit, Skill.md lifecycle, and regression matrix.
One logical task equals one commit.
verification: Review source references and ensure every unimplemented behavior is explicitly marked as proposed
recovery: Revert the documentation-only commit if it contradicts source or violates the allowed-path contract.
